audit.method: source review against the real DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 / Cordis 4.0.4 contracts plus executable probes against the built lib/ (fake Cordis host Context, real SessionEvent envelopes, real ToolExecution agent ids)

findings.bug: sessionIdOf() ignored exec.agent.id, so every tool call shared the "unsessioned" bucket: disclosure dedupe and the cumulative recall budget leaked across sessions
findings.fix: prefer exec.agent.id (the real SessionId contract); regression test keeps two sessions separate

findings.bug: session/event handler read event.content/event.message instead of the real envelope event.data, so habit detection never fired in a live DSH
findings.fix: read event.data first, skip non-user message sources; repeated signals are persisted from real envelopes

findings.bug: memory_forget exposed force=true to the model, letting it tombstone P0/user-protected memory
findings.fix: force removed from the model-facing schema; the engine still guards protected entries

findings.bug: the model could write priority P0 memory, creating entries protected from both the model and the lifecycle
findings.fix: memory_remember refuses P0; P0 stays user-authored only

findings.bug: every recall appended a full copy of the entry, so one memory grew entries.ndjson by ~520 B per recall forever
findings.fix: append counter + automatic compaction (keep the last row per id@version, audit type "compact") bounds each layer at ~256 rows

findings.bug: POST /dsh-memory/habits had no method/content-type/origin/body-size checks (simple-request CSRF + unbounded body)
findings.fix: POST only, application/json only, same-site/loopback origin check, 32 KiB body cap; status route GET-only

findings.bug: BudgetBook kept every session forever, each with its disclosed-id Set
findings.fix: LRU-style cap of 512 tracked sessions with an observable sessionCount

findings.bug: the write-guard scanned title+body only, so secrets inside tags or summary were persisted
findings.fix: summary and tags are scanned too; the guarded fields are normalized before the scan

findings.bug: memory_expand could inject beyond the remaining session recall budget
findings.fix: expand clamps to session.remaining(), reports chars/remainingChars and dedupes disclosure

findings.bug: habit patterns from the judge path were persisted without passing the credential write-guard
findings.fix: validateHabitProfile + write-guard on the habit layer; rejected patterns report line + pattern name only

findings.bug: disableHabitMemory compared a lowercased title against a mixed-case string, so deleting a habit profile left the habit memory active
findings.fix: case-insensitive comparison on both sides

findings.bug: unreadable NDJSON lines were skipped silently, hiding hand-edit corruption and data loss
findings.fix: corrupt line count surfaces through health as degraded (index/corrupt-layer-lines) with a self-healing recovery once the file is fixed

before.sessions: remember in session A then recall in session B returned items:0, deduped:1
before.habitSignals: 3 real user/message envelopes produced 0 signals (legacy shape produced 1)
before.growth: one memory + 200 recalls -> entries.ndjson 1 line/454 B to 201 lines/104654 B

after.sessions: session A and session B each recall their own disclosure set (items:1, deduped:[])
after.habitSignals: real envelopes produce 3 signals and one pending candidate
after.forget: force no longer exists in the tool schema; P0 delete is refused
after.growth: 400 recalls -> 146 lines/76504 B (compaction keeps each layer bounded)

remainingRisks: the resident index is rebuilt whenever memory changes, so a write mid-session is one intentional prefix change (cache miss) — documented tradeoff, not silent flapping
the running DSH process still needs a restart to pick up the audited lib (module cache)

audit2.method: strict three-phase audit: (1) read-only analysis, (2) test-only reproduction in tests/audit.spec.ts (8 failing probes + 2 passing probes on pre-fix code), (3) one minimal fix per defect in its own revertible commit

findings.bug: the returned entry carried the full stored body while only the truncated body was charged to the session disclosure budget
findings.fix: entry.body is the same bounded slice that is charged

findings.bug: statusReport() was called without a try/catch: an unreadable store threw out of the webserver handler (uncaught exception instead of visible failure)
findings.fix: route answers 500 with ok:false, error, warning, health

findings.bug: the request 'end' listener read hand-editable candidates.json unguarded: a malformed file threw out of the stream listener
findings.fix: listener body guarded, 500 with concrete reason + degraded habit feature

findings.bug: statusReport() -> memory.status() threw on an I/O error, so the model tool threw instead of reporting degradation
findings.fix: failures set recall degraded and return {ok:false, health, warning, error}

findings.bug: report.kept was assigned inside the per-layer loop, reporting only the last layer's count
findings.fix: accumulate kept across layers

findings.bug: a configured budget.degradeOrder was always overwritten with the default
findings.fix: keep the merged, configured order

findings.bug: the reducer kept the first row of the newest version while findAllCurrent keeps the last, so recallCount never accumulated and capacity eviction sorted on stale counts
findings.fix: reducer uses version >=

findings.bug: dedupe matched archived revisions, so re-writing superseded content returned an invisible archived version as deduped
findings.fix: dedupe considers active/dormant revisions only

audit2.functionalEquivalence: No public API, tool parameter/return, config default, data-file format, injection text or health-state semantic was changed. The existing 38 tests pass unmodified; only the eight defective behaviours changed.
docsCorrections: README: memory_expand wording now states the per-call/session cap instead of 'full body'

remainingRisks: the project store root is resolved from the process cwd at apply() time; a single DSH process opening several different repositories keeps writing the first repo's project store (documented limitation, not changed in this audit)
habit candidate/evidence writes (signals.ndjson, candidates.json, audit detail) are not covered by the credential write-guard; README claims 'all write paths', which overstates coverage
unloadThresholdChars is declared but unused (documented in README)
